Legal

Privacy Policy

Last updated: 31 July 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how Arponia Ventures Pvt Ltd ("Nagarva", "we", "us", or "our"), with its registered office in Tamil Nadu, India, handles information when you use the Nagarva application and our website.

It is written to meet our obligations under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (the "DPDP Act") and the Information Technology Act, 2000 and the rules made under it.

1 Who this policy covers

This policy applies to:

  • Customers — packers and movers businesses who register for and use Nagarva.
  • Customer staff — supervisors and employees a Customer adds to their account.
  • End customers — people who receive a survey, quotation, signature or tracking link sent by a Customer through Nagarva.
  • Website visitors — anyone browsing nagarva.in.

Nagarva is offered on a monthly subscription, beginning with a free trial. Plans may be cancelled at any time.

2 Information we collect

  • Business and account details given at registration — business name, owner name, mobile/WhatsApp number, email, city, GST number and branch details.
  • Login credentials — passwords and staff PINs, stored only as cryptographic hashes and never in readable form.
  • Configuration details used to brand your documents — logo, colours, bank and UPI details printed on your invoices.
  • Operational data you enter — leads, surveys, quotations, orders, invoices, payments, expenses, salary records, vehicles and trips.
  • Payment information — handled by our payment partner. We receive confirmation of payment and invoice details. We do not store full card details.
  • Usage and technical data — login timestamps, device type, app version, and error logs needed to keep the Service secure and working.

3 Data you store about your own customers

When you use Nagarva to manage leads, surveys, quotations, orders and invoices, you may enter information about your own customers — names, phone numbers, email addresses, pickup and delivery addresses, moving dates, household item lists, photographs and electronic signatures.

For that data you are the Data Fiduciary and we act only as a Data Processor, handling it on your instructions and solely to provide the Service. We do not use it for our own purposes, do not sell it, and do not use it to market to anyone.

You are responsible for obtaining any consents required from your own customers, and for responding to their requests about their data.

If you are an end customer of a packers and movers business and want your data corrected or erased, please contact that business directly, as they control it. If you cannot reach them, contact us using the details in Section 13 and we will help you identify and reach the right party.

4 Public links sent to your customers

Nagarva generates links that your customers open in a browser — to submit a household survey, view a quotation, sign a document, or track an order. These links carry a single-use token, expire fourteen days after they are issued, and become unusable once acted on. The pages they open show only the information needed for that task and never expose any other business's data.

5 How we use information

  • To create, run and support your account and application.
  • To authenticate you — verifying your email address, managing login sessions and staff PINs.
  • To communicate with you about setup, support, billing and important service updates.
  • To manage your trial, subscription and payments.
  • To maintain the security, integrity and reliability of the Service, including detecting abuse and investigating incidents.
  • To meet legal, tax and regulatory obligations.

We rely on the consent you give when you register and accept this policy, and on the legitimate uses permitted under the DPDP Act. You may withdraw consent at any time, as described in Section 10 — though withdrawing consent to essential processing means we can no longer provide the Service.

6 Data isolation and security

Nagarva is a multi-tenant platform. All Customers are served from shared infrastructure, and each Customer's records are separated by row-level security enforced in the database itself: every record is tagged to the business that owns it, and every query is filtered against the identity of the person making it. No Customer can read, alter or discover another Customer's data.

We apply reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect personal data, including:

  • Encryption in transit (HTTPS/TLS) across the platform.
  • Passwords and staff PINs stored only as cryptographic hashes.
  • Single-use, time-limited tokens for customer-facing links.
  • Role-based access, so staff see only what their role requires.
  • Immediate revocation of access when a staff member is deactivated.

Our own access. A small number of authorised Nagarva personnel hold administrative access, used only to operate the platform — providing support at your request, managing subscriptions and trials, investigating security incidents, and complying with legal obligations. We do not browse or use your business data outside these purposes.

No system can be guaranteed perfectly secure. If a personal data breach occurs, we will notify the Data Protection Board of India and affected users as required by the DPDP Act.

7 WhatsApp and Meta messaging

Where your plan includes the official Meta WhatsApp Business API, messages such as order-status updates, quotations, invoices and payment links are delivered through Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform. Those messages are also subject to Meta's and WhatsApp's own terms and privacy policies. You are responsible for messaging your customers in line with applicable laws and WhatsApp policies.

8 Sharing and disclosure

We do not sell personal data. We share it only where necessary, with:

  • Service providers who help us run Nagarva — including cloud hosting and database providers, website hosting, transactional email providers, messaging partners and payment processors — under appropriate confidentiality obligations.
  • Authorities, where required by law, regulation or valid legal process.
  • A successor, in the event of a business reorganisation, merger or acquisition, subject to this policy.

9 Where data is stored, and how long we keep it

Data is stored on cloud infrastructure which may be located outside India. Where personal data is transferred outside India, we do so in accordance with the DPDP Act and any restrictions notified by the Central Government. Our providers are contractually required to maintain appropriate security.

  • Active accounts — retained for as long as you use the Service.
  • Closed accounts — deleted or anonymised within 90 days of closure, except where we must retain records to meet legal or tax obligations.
  • Financial records — retained as required by Indian tax law, currently eight years.
  • Survey, quotation and signature links — tokens expire fourteen days after issue.

10 Your rights

Under the DPDP Act you have the right to:

  • Access — ask what personal data we hold about you and how it is processed.
  • Correction — have inaccurate or incomplete data corrected, completed or updated.
  • Erasure — ask us to delete your data, unless we are required to keep it by law.
  • Withdraw consent — at any time.
  • Nominate — appoint another person to exercise these rights on your behalf in the event of death or incapacity.
  • Grievance redressal — raise a complaint with our Grievance Officer (Section 13) before approaching the Data Protection Board of India.

To make a request, contact us using the details below. We will respond within 30 days. You may also request permanent deletion of your account and data at any time using our account deletion form.

11 Cookies and website

Our website may use essential cookies and basic analytics to keep the site working and to understand general usage. You can control cookies through your browser settings. The Nagarva application itself uses only the storage needed to keep you signed in and to run the app.

12 Children

Nagarva is a business tool intended for registered businesses and adults aged 18 or over. It is not directed at children, and we do not knowingly collect their personal data. If we learn that we have, we will delete it.
